review.body:
<!-- factory-judge-review round=2 -->
### Factory judge · round 2 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — The amended existing test and the new --force test both assert that factory.yml is unchanged (including the CRLF custom content), that factory.factory.yml equals the template, and that no .bak is written.
- A2: met — The new test covers a first run without --force and a re-run with --force after removing factory.yml. Both write the template and no sibling.
- A3: met — The new test asserts that stdout contains '.github/workflows/factory.factory.yml' and 'merge it by hand'.

<details><summary>3 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- writeReplacing loses its doc comment and may now be unused `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:135` — Delete writeReplacing if it has no other caller. Otherwise restore a comment that says what it is still used for.
- Appended delete note depends on writeBeside's message shape `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:503` — Have writeBeside take an optional trailing note, or build the factory.yml message in full here.
- Sibling in .github/workflows is only guarded by a printed message `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:492` — Have `factory doctor` flag a leftover `.github/workflows/*.factory.yml`, or write a gitignore entry for it.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: writeReplacing loses its doc comment and may now be unused
suggestions.detail: The removed comment described writeReplacing as the writer for factory.yml, which was its only documented caller. If nothing else calls it, it is dead code. Under noUnusedLocals or no-unused-vars, lint or typecheck would go red. If something else does call it, it is now the only helper in the file without a comment.
suggestions.repro: Run `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run lint` on the change, and grep init.ts for other `writeReplacing(` calls.
suggestions.fix: Delete writeReplacing if it has no other caller. Otherwise restore a comment that says what it is still used for.

suggestions.title: Appended delete note depends on writeBeside's message shape
suggestions.detail: The ', then delete it (...)' suffix is glued onto whatever note writeBeside returns. If that note ends in a full stop, or isn't phrased as an instruction, the printed line reads awkwardly. The other beside entries also lack this suffix, so the output is inconsistent.
suggestions.repro: Run `factory init --force` on a repo whose factory.yml differs from the template, and read the printed line for factory.factory.yml.
suggestions.fix: Have writeBeside take an optional trailing note, or build the factory.yml message in full here.

suggestions.title: Sibling in .github/workflows is only guarded by a printed message
suggestions.detail: factory.factory.yml is a valid workflow named 'factory'. A `git add -A` commits it, and it then runs on GitHub alongside the real one with a duplicate check name. Only the console note prevents this.
suggestions.repro: Run `factory init --force` on a customised factory.yml, then `git add -A && git commit` and push.
suggestions.fix: Have `factory doctor` flag a leftover `.github/workflows/*.factory.yml`, or write a gitignore entry for it.

acceptance.note: The amended existing test and the new --force test both assert that factory.yml is unchanged (including the CRLF custom content), that factory.factory.yml equals the template, and that no .bak is written.
The new test covers a first run without --force and a re-run with --force after removing factory.yml. Both write the template and no sibling.
The new test asserts that stdout contains '.github/workflows/factory.factory.yml' and 'merge it by hand'.
